positive.description: This label should be applied to content that expresses favorable, supportive, or optimistic sentiments. It includes praise, encouragement, appreciation, or anything that conveys a positive outlook or good news.
example: I love this idea, it's amazing!
Great job on the presentation, you did fantastic!

negative.description: This label should be assigned to content that expresses unfavorable, critical, or pessimistic sentiments. It includes complaints, criticism, frustration, or anything that conveys a negative outlook or bad news.
example: This is terrible, I can’t believe this happened.
I’m so disappointed with how things turned out.
